trail.description: Chronological local history. Current evidence remains in the Evidence tab.
trail.legacyWarning: Activity before full Research Trail tracking may be incomplete. Only recorded events are shown.
trail.legacyNote: This historical event did not record note versions.
trail.localLabelNotice: E# labels belong only to this question; unit IDs may change after reprocessing.

trail.payloadTooLarge: Research event exceeds the 2.5 MB payload limit. Nothing was truncated.

trail.invalidLimit: Choose a trail page size between 1 and 100.

claims.title: Findings
claims.humanOnly: Statements, notes and evidence relationships are written and classified by the researcher. PETRUS does not generate claims.
claims.reviewMeaning: Reviewed means reviewed by the researcher. It does not mean verified scientific truth or peer review. Counts describe relationships, not evidence strength.
claims.classificationMeaning: The researcher classified these relationships. Semantic support or contradiction has not been verified by PETRUS.
claims.chooseEvidence: Choose saved evidence from this session
claims.noSnapshot: Historical source text unavailable; no text was reconstructed.
claims.reviewWarning: Review status is preserved. Check missing, removed or unavailable linked evidence.
claims.invalidFields: Invalid claim fields. Only explicit human changes are accepted.
claims.invalidStatement: Enter a nonblank statement of at most 10,000 characters, without NUL characters. Valid text is preserved exactly.
claims.invalidNote: The note must contain at most 100,000 characters, without NUL characters. Nothing was truncated.
claims.archivedReadOnly: This claim is archived and read-only. Restore it before making changes.
claims.invalidFilter: Invalid claim filter or page size (1–100).
claims.invalidReviewStatus: Choose Draft or Reviewed by researcher.
claims.reviewNeedsEvidence: Link at least one evidence item before marking the claim reviewed.
claims.crossSessionLink: Claim and evidence must belong to the same research session.
claims.tooManyLinks: A claim supports at most 100 evidence relationships. Unlink an item before adding another.
